info.title: Numsync full rest api
info.description: This is the Numsync Full Rest Api

tags.name: User
tags.description: Operations that can be done by the agent software, mobile app or any usage performed by a user account

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Operations that can only be done by the admin users

get.summary: Reset password by email
get.description: Reset account password from email given in URL. If success, a link to reset the password is send to given email.

post.summary: Create a new user account
post.description: Create a new user from Account model json object in request body. Note that 'id' and 'token' account attributes are not required.

403.description: Cannot create user for some security reasons

post.summary: Authenticate a user account by email with superAdmin account credentials
post.description: Authenticate a user account from email given in URL with superAdmin account login and password attributes in request body.

delete.summary: Remove a token for an account API user
delete.description: Remove a token account  given in URL from authenticated account token cache server. Note : This is helpfull to force re-authentication for an specific account.

post.summary: Authenticate a user account
post.description: Authenticate a user with only login and password attributes in request body.

get.summary: Get account info quota
get.description: Get info quota for account authenticated by token in header.

get.summary: Get active account infos by email
get.description: Get active account infos from email given in URL.

post.summary: Register an agent
post.description: Agent registration with user account credentials and agent json model (agent ID and terminal UID). Note : Before an agent belong to an account can be authenticated, needs to register agent with agentId and terminalUID.

404.description: Agent authentication failed. Agent not found

get.summary: Get agent infos
get.description: Get agent infos for agent authenticate by token given in header.

post.summary: Authenticate an agent
post.description: Authenticate an agent with user account credentials and agent json model (agent ID and terminal UID). Note : Before an agent can be authenticated, needs to be registered from 'auth/register' URL service.

404.description: Agent authentication failed. Agent not found

post.summary: Bind an agent
post.description: Bind an agent with user account credentials and agent json model (agent ID and terminal UID). Note : Before an agent belong to an account can be authenticated, needs to bind agentId with the terminalUID.

404.description: Agent authentication failed. Agent not found
